instruction: From '~/Documents/awesome-desktop/expe-results.xlsx', extract GPT-4 model results and insert them in table format into the 'Main Results' section of the current report.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting GPT-4 performance data from an Excel file and inserting it as a table into a specific section of a LibreOffice Writer document. The evaluator verifies that a table exists in the document with GPT-4 data. Variation maintains similar complexity to original by checking for table insertion with specific model data.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts document structure with section context - iterates through document elements tracking current heading/section for each table (docx.py:59-93)
Metric properly verifies section placement - checks if GPT-4 table is in 'Main Results' section with case-insensitive matching (docx.py:114-120)
Complete coverage of instruction requirements - verifies table exists, contains GPT-4 data, has correct values, and is in the specified section
Sound partial credit logic - gives 0.3-0.5 score if GPT-4 table exists but in wrong section, 0.5-1.0 if in correct section
Robust value matching - handles both string and numeric comparisons with tolerance for floating point values (docx.py:89-102)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Section detection relies on proper heading styles (Heading/Title). If user uses manual formatting (bold text) instead of heading styles, section detection may fail. Consider adding fallback logic for common heading patterns.
Minor: Could optionally verify header row matches expected headers list (currently only validates min_columns), though this is not critical since GPT-4 row values are validated
